prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: premium business-card brandbook mockup
Primary request: Create one complete, photorealistic Magic Mirror business-card scene using the supplied production marks exactly.
Input images:
- Image 1 is the exact approved Ink combined lockup. Preserve its lettering, spacing, proportions, and the custom lens/focus icon replacing the ‘o’ in ‘Mirror.’
- Image 2 is the exact approved Acid standalone icon. Preserve its S-curve lens shape and two focus-corner brackets.
Scene/backdrop: Two overlapping premium uncoated business cards resting on a clean Cloud #F4F3F1 studio surface.
Subject and card designs:
- Top/front card: solid Acid #D7FF3F stock with the exact Image 1 combined lockup printed flat in Ink #17171A, large and centered with generous margins.
- Lower/back card: solid Ink #17171A stock with the exact Image 2 icon printed flat in Acid #D7FF3F. Add only two small lines of copy: ‘AI VIRTUAL TRY-ON’ and ‘HACKATHON PROTOTYPE • 2026’.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic editorial product photography; restrained fashion-magazine art direction.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 frame, slightly elevated three-quarter view, cards overlap diagonally but every required mark and line of copy remains readable; generous negative space and page-ready crop.
Lighting/mood: soft editorial studio light, controlled natural shadows, tactile but minimal.
Color palette: Cloud #F4F3F1 surface, Acid #D7FF3F, Ink #17171A only for the designed cards and artwork.
Materials/textures: subtle uncoated paper grain; ink should follow the card surface and perspective naturally.
Text (verbatim): ‘AI VIRTUAL TRY-ON’ and ‘HACKATHON PROTOTYPE • 2026’. The supplied lockup already says Magic Mirror; do not typeset the brand name again.
Constraints: preserve both supplied marks at very high fidelity; no redesign, no substituted letters, no warped logo, no extra copy; physically integrate print into paper perspective and texture.
Avoid: extra logos, unrelated marks, gradients, foil, gloss, embossing, watermarks, hands, props, excessive depth of field, illegible text, distorted logo, shadows or highlights added inside the logo artwork.

logo_fidelity.notes: Magic Mirror is correctly spelled; the editorial letterforms and lens-shaped custom o are recognizable and materially undistorted.

icon_fidelity.notes: The standalone S-curve lens and both focus-corner brackets are present and recognizable.

copy_accuracy.notes: Both required lines are present and legible: AI VIRTUAL TRY-ON and HACKATHON PROTOTYPE • 2026.

physical_integration.notes: Artwork follows card perspective and paper grain without appearing pasted on.

palette_compliance.notes: Designed brand layers use the approved Acid and Ink pairing on a Cloud studio surface; tonal variation is attributable to scene lighting and paper texture.

stray_branding_and_watermarks.notes: No unrelated logos, marks, props, or watermarks are visible.

page_ready_crop.notes: The 3:2 composition leaves usable Cloud negative space and keeps both cards fully readable.

decision: Accepted the first complete ImageGen pass. It cleared the approximately 95% mockup gate, so the permitted targeted retry and compositing fallback were not used.
